items.title: A continuous surjection transports irreducible components to irreducible components
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a continuous surjection with irreducible fibres induces a bijection between the irreducible components of source and target (author lemma at source lines 1165-1170, label lemma-surjective-continuous-irreducible-components). The proof (source lines 1172-1181) uses the two statements on images and preimages of irreducible subsets to get surjectivity and injectivity of the induced map (proof lines 1172-1180). The two applications are the substance. H3.
